mapper.select: SELECT sh.studentid AS studentid, s.studentno AS studentno, s.studentname AS studentname, sh.content AS content, sh.filepath AS filepath FROM studenthomework sh LEFT JOIN student s ON sh.studentid = s.studentid WHERE sh.homeworkid = #{homeworkid} AND sh.status IN (1, 2)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plagiarism_report (homeworkid, teacherid, pair_count, flagged_count, max_similarity, threshold, result_json, create_time) VALUES (#{homeworkid}, #{teacherid}, #{pairCount}, #{flaggedCount}, #{maxSimilarity}, #{threshold}, #{resultJson}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT pr.*, h.title AS homeworktitle FROM plagiarism_report pr LEFT JOIN homework h ON pr.homeworkid = h.homeworkid WHERE pr.homeworkid = #{homeworkid} ORDER BY pr.id DESC

SELECT pr.*, h.title AS homeworktitle, c.coursename FROM plagiarism_report pr LEFT JOIN homework h ON pr.homeworkid = h.homeworkid LEFT JOIN course c ON h.courseid = c.courseid WHERE pr.teacherid = #{teacherid} ORDER BY pr.id DESC
SELECT pr.*, h.title AS homeworktitle FROM plagiarism_report pr LEFT JOIN homework h ON pr.homeworkid = h.homeworkid WHERE pr.id = #{id}
